title: @NotBlank is there and nothing gets validated
summary: The DTO is covered in constraints, but without @Valid an empty value goes straight through.

turns.user: put @NotBlank and @Email on SignupRequest and I can still sign up with an empty string. why

assistant.body: Short answer: the controller parameter has no @Valid. Constraint annotations do nothing on their own. Spring only validates a parameter marked @Valid or @Validated. With it, a violation throws MethodArgumentNotValidException before the method runs, which guarantees a 400. Note: since Boot 2.3 the validator itself only exists if spring-boot-starter-validation is on the classpath.

turns.user: ok 400 now. but an empty postalCode inside address still passes. actually no address at all passes too

assistant.body: Got it. Validation does not walk into a nested object by itself. Put @Valid on the field too and AddressRequest gets checked. @Valid lets null through, though, so making address required also takes @NotNull.
